title: Set up Docker
goal: Check that Docker works on your machine and that the lab has the room and ports it needs.

title: Launch the containers
goal: Understand the lab's containers and start all of them.

title: Verify service health
goal: Check that each service of the lab is up and know what healthy means for each.

title: The database and its users
goal: Understand the database setup the lab performs and check the result.

title: The log and RepAgent
goal: See where Sybase records changes and how RepAgent reads and ships them.

title: Set up replication
goal: Mark tables for replication, start the connector and RepAgent in the right order.

title: The Java connector, file by file
goal: Read every class of the connector with notes on what each class and method is for.

title: Build and connect to Kafka
goal: Build the JAR, load it into Kafka Connect and see the topics.

title: End-to-end demonstration
goal: Change a record and verify the events in the right Kafka topic.
